'''''Aequationes Mathematicae''''' is a [[mathematical journal]]. It is primarily devoted to [[functional equation]]s, but also publishes papers in [[dynamical system]]s, [[combinatorics]], and [[geometry]].<ref name=scimago/> As well as publishing regular journal submissions on these topics, it also regularly reports on international symposia on functional equations and produces bibliographies on the subject.<ref name=pk>{{citation|title=Functional Equations and Inequalities with Applications|series=Springer Monographs in Mathematics|first=Palaniappan|last=Kannappan|publisher=Springer Science+Business Media|year=2009|isbn=9780387894928|page=xi|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=SdZoCM2OeuIC&pg=PR11}}</ref>

[[János Aczél (mathematician)|János Aczél]] founded the journal in 1968 at the [[University of Waterloo]], in part because of the long publication delays of up to four years in other journals at the time of its founding.<ref name=pk/><ref>{{citation|title=In Celebration of Canadian Scientists: A Decade of Killam Laureates|editor1-first=Geraldine A.|editor1-last=Kenney-Wallace|editor1-link=Geraldine A. Kenney-Wallace|editor2-first=Mel G.|editor2-last=MacLeod|editor3-first=Ralph G.|editor3-last=Stanton|editor3-link= Ralph Gordon Stanton |publisher=Charles Babbage Research Centre|year=1990|isbn=9780919611221|page=103}}</ref>
It is currently published by [[Springer Science+Business Media]], with [[Zsolt Páles]] of the [[University of Debrecen]] as its editor in chief. [[János Aczél (mathematician)|János Aczél]] remains its honorary editor in chief.<ref>{{citation|url=https://www.springer.com/birkhauser/mathematics/journal/10?detailsPage=editorialBoard|title=Editorial board|work=Aequationes Mathematicae|publisher=Springer Science+Business Media|accessdate=2017-10-08|archive-date=2008-06-14|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080614044138/https://www.springer.com/birkhauser/mathematics/journal/10?detailsPage=editorialBoard|url-status=dead}}</ref>

It is frequently listed as a second-quartile mathematics journal by [[SCImago Journal Rank]].<ref name=scimago>{{citation|url=http://www.scimagojr.com/journalsearch.php?q=24573&tip=sid|title= Aequationes Mathematicae|work=Scimago Journal & Country Rank|accessdate=2017-10-08}}</ref>
